caption: The video captures a calm lake at twilight from a boat, its dark prow silhouetted below. Tall pines form a black island on the right, mirrored in the water, while a low forest line glows against an orange-to-blue sky streaked with pink contrails. A thin layer of mist lies above the lake, and a floating dock with a ladder sits in the middle distance beside a low boat-shaped silhouette. In the near water, circular ripples spread outward from a disturbance point beside emergent reed stalks. The ripple rings enlarge and soften as the clip progresses, while the small dark disturbance point appears to drift slowly leftward. The dock, boat, pines, and tree line keep fixed positions, while their reflections shimmer. The foreground boat and framing remain steady, leaving the expanding rings as the clearest motion.
